As our Surgical Technologist, you will help our surgical team and patients by providing critical technical support during surgical procedures so they can achieve optimal patient outcomes and ensure smooth, safe operations within the perioperative environment. This role is essential for delivering quality surgical care across various patient populations.

Every day you will perform as a skilled Scrub Technician, proficiently handling surgical instruments and equipment. You will be expected to safely operate and maintain a wide array of specialized surgical tools, including CUSA Neuro Suction Irrigator, microscopes, power equipment (drills, saws), autoclaves, and instrument washers, in strict accordance with manufacturer instructions and Medical Center policy.

To be successful in this role, you will possess current Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) and Basic Life Support (BLS-CPR) certifications. You must have a minimum of six months of recent experience in an acute care Surgery Department, or have completed an ORT externship on-site, demonstrating the ability to perform as scrub personnel in all specialties. Strong judgment, adaptability, and excellent communication skills are also crucial.

To be successful in this role, you will need a CST certification and at least six months of acute care surgery department experience, or a recently completed ORT externship. Candidates with military surgical tech experience are also highly valued. A strong understanding of medical center policies and procedures, coupled with excellent communication skills and the ability to maintain professional camaraderie, are essential. Your commitment to patient care, combined with proficiency in handling heavy equipment and a proactive approach to problem-solving, will ensure your success in this rewarding healthcare career opportunity.
Completion of Operating Room Technician Training Course preferred.
